title: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
title_zh: MixReact：通过离散—连续混合 Transformer 实现多模态线索驱动的物理人形控制
abstract_en: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/
abstract_zh: 现有线索驱动的人形反应生成方法支持的模态有限，且多停留在运动学层面，生成的动作容易出现不符合物理规律的伪影。论文提出 MixReact，一个统一处理文本、音频和视频线索的物理人形控制框架。其状态预测模块 DisCo-MoT（Discrete–Continuous Mixture of Transformers）通过单向混合注意力连接离散掩码建模分支和连续自回归扩散分支：离散上下文引导连续预测，减轻同一线索对应多种合理反应时的动作平均化问题；直接预测连续状态则绕开了离散表示的解码瓶颈。执行模块 HAT（History-aware Action Transformer）结合预测的下一状态和实际执行历史输出控制动作，在物理仿真中实现闭环控制。三种模态上的实验表明，MixReact 相较基线在反应保真度、多样性和物理一致性上均有提升；消融实验验证了各组件的互补作用。
key_points_zh: MixReact 将文本、音频和视频驱动的反应生成统一为物理仿真中的闭环人形控制任务。
DisCo-MoT 通过单向混合注意力，用离散上下文引导连续扩散预测，减轻一对多反应生成中的动作平均化，同时绕开离散解码瓶颈。
HAT 根据预测的下一状态和实际执行历史输出控制动作，使控制器能够依据执行反馈调整后续动作。
三种模态上的实验均显示，MixReact 在保真度、多样性和物理一致性上优于基线；消融实验支持各组件的互补性。
